phase.goal: PHASE 1 — INTELLIGENCE, BUSINESS FOUNDATION, TRUST ARCHITECTURE, AND PREMIUM EXPERIENCE

milestone.description: Repository/project foundation, durable multi-tenant state, provider abstraction

completed: P1-01: Repo/app foundation (Next.js 16 App Router, strict TypeScript, Tailwind 4, ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, Playwright, Prisma 7 + Postgres via Docker, env validation, deterministic health check)

P1-02: Data layer — User/Session/Organization/Membership/Project schema + migration, password hashing (scrypt), session lifecycle, tenant-aware authorization (requireOrganizationMembership/requireProjectAccess), organization/project service layer with tenant-isolation integration tests against a real Postgres test database

P1-03: Canonical Product State (append-only versioned), Product DNA (versioned with merge-not-erase partial updates), Product Memory (discrete typed entries), Product Knowledge relationships (typed node/edge graph with stable ids, same-project + no-self-loop constraints), all project-scoped and tenant-isolated

P1-04: AI provider abstraction (MockAIProvider fully implemented, AnthropicAIProvider stubbed for Phase 3), Intent Resolver, deterministic Impact Analysis foundation, product-facing Decision Ledger with disclosure tiers (ROUTINE/IMPORTANT/CONSEQUENTIAL) and approval flow, Orchestration Contract change-flow skeleton wiring them together

P1-05: Platform-wide versioned Supported Capability Registry mirroring Master Spec §4.3 classification exactly, seeded with truthful Phase 1 status, and a Feasibility Engine that looks up capability keys against the registry rather than inventing feasibility claims

P1-06: Requirements Engine, Business Model Brief + monetization recommendations, unit-economics assumptions (all fields honestly labeled unknown/estimate, never fabricated), and generateProductIntelligence wiring all of it into a persisted Canonical Product State version, Product DNA version, Requirement knowledge nodes, and Product Memory entries; wired into beginChangeFlow for describe_idea intents

P1-07: Product-facing Event Ledger (append-only audit trail), Evidence Ledger (backs every Truth Status claim with a verifiable record), and Truth Status (versioned per subjectKey, mapped conservatively from platform capability level to per-project status — SUPPORTED_NOW never auto-implies IMPLEMENTED for a project, only the platform's own already-built capabilities do); wired into generateProductIntelligence and the Decision Ledger
active: P1-08: Integrations, credential-vault architecture, governance profile

testStatus.unit: pass (39/39: env 4, slug 4, mock-provider 4, anthropic-provider 1, impact-analysis 6, requirements-engine 10, business-intelligence 7, unit-economics 3)
testStatus.integration: pass (83/83: users 5, session 5, tenancy 7, product-state 5, product-dna 6, product-memory 4, product-knowledge 5, decisions 7, intent-resolver 3, change-flow 3, capability-registry 5, seed-data 3, feasibility 5, product-intelligence 6, events 3, evidence 3, truth-status 4, truth-status-sync 4)

knownLimitations: Auth/tenancy/product-state/orchestration/registry/truth-status exist only as a service/library layer — no UI, no Server Actions, no HTTP routes wire them up yet. That is P1-10/P1-11.
Tenant isolation is proven at the service+authz layer against a real database, not yet at the HTTP boundary (no routes exist to attack yet).

AI provider is mock-only; Requirements Engine, Business Model Brief, and unit economics are deterministic/template-based, not real product or market intelligence — but this is now an honest, queryable Truth Status fact per project, not just a code comment.

Evidence in Phase 1 is necessarily about intelligence-generation claims (registry lookups), not implementation/test/build/deployment evidence, since no generation system exists yet (Phase 2). Evidence types will expand once that becomes true.
Phase 1's own customer flow (§51) never requires an edit; full conversational editing with impact-aware regeneration is Phase 2 scope (§55, §57) and is not implemented.
Product Knowledge graph only exercises REQUIREMENT/WORKFLOW node types so far; no generation system yet produces Screen/Action/DataModel nodes (Phase 2 concern).
No customer-owned integrations, credential vault, or governance profile yet — P1-08, next.
No automated e2e (Playwright) coverage yet — nothing customer-facing exists to test end-to-end.
nextAction: Begin P1-08: Integration Requirements tracking, secure credential-vault architecture (encrypted server-side, never in chat/bundles/prompts/logs per Master Spec §4.7/§30), and governance profile/requirement architecture (§32) plus policy-document model scaffolding (§34).
